text: The refurbished modular span at half price would be the optimal choice for replacing the old footbridge. This solution offers both improved reliability and enhanced safety without compromising on quality or exceeding costs significantly. Additionally, it provides substantial savings that can be reinvested back into improving local infrastructure, thereby creating a more resilient community. Choosing this option aligns with my commitment to prioritizing long-term benefits over short-term gains, ensuring that the new bridge serves as a reliable asset well into the future.
